name: ColecoVision
significance: Demonstrated that near-perfect arcade-faithful ports were possible on home televisions, setting a new visual benchmark prior to the 1983 crash.

editorialContent.overview: Delivered near-arcade-quality home conversions, famously bundled with Nintendo's Donkey Kong arcade license.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Demonstrated that near-perfect arcade-faithful ports were possible on home televisions, setting a new visual benchmark prior to the 1983 crash.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: Dual numeric keypad controllers with short joystick and side buttons
